To allocate bitmaps
column2: the mpi3mr driver calculates sizes of bitmaps using

column1: byte as unit. However
column2: bitmap helper functions assume that bitmaps are

column1: allocated using unsigned long as unit. This gap causes memory access beyond
the bitmap sizes and results in ""BUG: KASAN: slab-out-of-bounds"".  The BUG
was observed at firmware download to eHBA-9600. Call trace indicated that
the out-of-bounds access happened in find_first_zero_bit() called from
mpi3mr_send_event_ack() for miroc->evtack_cmds_bitmap.
To fix the BUG
column2: do not use bytes to manage bitmap sizes. Instead

column1: number of bits
column2: and call bitmap helper functions which take number of bits

column1: as arguments. For memory allocation
kzalloc() and krealloc(). For memory free
kfree(). For zero clear
Remove three fields for bitmap byte sizes in struct scmd_priv which are no
longer required. Replace the field dev_handle_bitmap_sz with
dev_handle_bitmap_bits to keep number of bits of removepend_bitmap across
resize.
